$comment: Version contract for the Azure Landing Zone Factory. This file is read by site/ (stamped into every exported lz-config.json) and by the renderer, which emits a factory-version.json stamp into the generated repository root (manifest mode version-stamp). Bump factoryVersion on any change to the schema, templates, or scripts.

contracts.$comment: Must match the const value of schemaVersion in factory/schema/lz-config.schema.json. The renderer refuses any config whose schemaVersion it does not implement.

landingZone.$comment: Version of the emitted landing-zone content (templates + workflows + docs). Tracked separately from factoryVersion so tooling-only changes do not force customer-repo upgrades.
landingZone.$layersComment: Layers the template corpus can actually emit. Guard G21 reads this list and refuses to render a configuration selecting anything absent from it. Workload spokes and sandbox estates are per-estate work inside the generated repository (ADR 0017), not generator layers.

avm.$comment: Azure Verified Modules pattern-module pins the emitted root modules reference, and the pinned ALZ library ref. These set the INITIAL pins only — Renovate owns them inside the generated repository from delivery onward. Verified snapshot of 2026-08; every pin is re-verified at execution time by terraform init on generated output.

compatibility.$comment: 0.10.0 is the generator-only refactor (ADR 0013): the emitted architecture changed from vendored bespoke modules to AVM registry references. No in-place upgrade path exists from 0.9.0-generated repositories; regenerate, or migrate state manually.

releaseGates.$comment: v1.0.0 cannot be declared until every gate below is true. The dogfood gate was replaced by the end-to-end generation proof (docs/refactor/VALIDATION.md) when the self-deploying live tree was removed.
